audio_first.master_track: user-specified or user-provided genuine Hua Chenyu live recording, approximately 30 seconds
audio_first.voice_policy: do not synthesize or imitate Hua Chenyu's singing voice
audio_first.editing_rule: mark cuts from the real waveform, downbeats and phrase boundaries
audio_first.generation_audio: feed time-windowed reference audio into MiniMax H3 Ref2VA when useful; replace all generated singing with the genuine master in post

video_structure.reason: one high-energy action per container; reduces identity drift and avoids slow 2x15s pacing

girl_identity.policy: original user photos go directly into every relevant generation; no generative lookalike intermediate
prohibited: identity judged only by visual description

hua_chenyu_identity.source_policy: official studio/concert photography or user-provided live footage; do not mix eras
prohibited: silver hair or red microphone used as identity substitute

primary_workflow.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA final configuration
primary_workflow.prior_evidence: single-person clear frontal anchors scored 0.72-0.89; median depends on face visibility

post_identity_repair.method: track two faces independently; repair girl and Hua Chenyu sequentially with isolated masks; prevent cross-ID leakage

identity_gate.failure_action: reject or run role-isolated identity repair; never accept costume/hair similarity as identity

open_inputs: song title and exact live-recording time window
concert year/era and Hua Chenyu appearance
approval_gate: after open inputs are resolved, generate v2 contracts and obtain new direct user approval before any paid task
